question.en: Do I qualify for Massachusetts Prescription Advantage in 2026?
question.es: ¿Califico para Prescription Advantage de Massachusetts en 2026?

shortAnswer.en: Yes, if you are 65+ or have a qualifying disability and meet income limits.
shortAnswer.es: Si, si tiene 65 anos o mas o tiene una discapacidad calificada y cumple los limites de ingresos.

fullAnswer.en: Prescription Advantage is Massachusetts' State Pharmaceutical Assistance Program (SPAP), run by the Executive Office of Elder Affairs. Massachusetts residents who are 65 or older and enrolled in Medicare qualify if their gross annual household income is below 500% of the federal poverty level ($79,800 for a single person in 2026). Residents 65 or older who do not have Medicare qualify with no income cap. Adults under 65 who have a qualifying disability, work 40 hours or fewer per month, and have income at or below 188% FPL ($29,985 for a single person in 2026) also qualify. The program wraps around your Medicare Part D plan to cap your annual prescription drug costs based on your income tier.
fullAnswer.es: Prescription Advantage es el Programa Estatal de Asistencia Farmaceutica (SPAP) de Massachusetts, administrado por la Oficina Ejecutiva de Asuntos de Adultos Mayores. Los residentes de Massachusetts que tienen 65 anos o mas y estan inscritos en Medicare califican si su ingreso bruto anual del hogar es inferior al 500% del nivel federal de pobreza ($79,800 para una persona sola en 2026). Los residentes de 65 anos o mas que no tienen Medicare califican sin limite de ingresos. Los adultos menores de 65 anos que tienen una discapacidad calificada, trabajan 40 horas o menos por mes y tienen ingresos iguales o inferiores al 188% del FPL ($29,985 para una persona sola en 2026) tambien califican. El programa complementa su plan Medicare Parte D para limitar sus costos anuales de medicamentos recetados segun su nivel de ingresos.

h1.en: Do I Qualify for Massachusetts Prescription Advantage? (2026)
h1.es: Como Calificar para Prescription Advantage de Massachusetts (2026)

introParagraphs.en: Prescription Advantage is Massachusetts' state-run prescription drug assistance program, administered by the Commonwealth's Executive Office of Elder Affairs. Unlike standard Medicaid (MassHealth), Prescription Advantage specifically targets prescription drug costs for seniors and people with disabilities who earn too much to qualify for MassHealth's drug coverage but still struggle with out-of-pocket pharmacy bills. The program wraps around a member's existing Medicare Part D plan or other primary drug coverage to cap annual drug spending based on income.
introParagraphs.es: Prescription Advantage es el programa estatal de asistencia para medicamentos recetados de Massachusetts, administrado por la Oficina Ejecutiva de Asuntos de Adultos Mayores del Estado. A diferencia del Medicaid estandar (MassHealth), Prescription Advantage atiende especificamente los costos de medicamentos recetados para adultos mayores y personas con discapacidades que ganan demasiado para calificar para la cobertura de medicamentos de MassHealth, pero aun tienen dificultades con las facturas de farmacia. El programa complementa el plan Medicare Parte D existente de un miembro u otra cobertura de medicamentos principal para limitar el gasto anual en medicamentos segun los ingresos.

introParagraphs.en: Massachusetts residents who are 65 or older may qualify if their household income is under 500% of the 2026 Federal Poverty Level. Adults under 65 who qualify through a disability pathway face a lower income ceiling of 188% FPL, calculated using Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) rules. Prescription Advantage income thresholds scale with family size, rising roughly $27,900 per additional household member at the 500% FPL ceiling. This guide covers the 2026 income thresholds, the copay tier structure, what the program covers, how to apply, and what to do if your application is denied.
introParagraphs.es: Los residentes de Massachusetts que tienen 65 anos o mas pueden calificar si su ingreso familiar es inferior al 500% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza de 2026. Los adultos menores de 65 anos que califican a traves de la via de discapacidad enfrentan un techo de ingresos mas bajo del 188% del FPL, calculado usando las reglas de Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI). Los umbrales de ingresos de Prescription Advantage aumentan con el tamano de la familia, aumentando aproximadamente $27,900 por miembro adicional del hogar en el techo del 500% del FPL.

numberedSteps.en: Step 1: Gather your documents. Collect proof of Massachusetts residency, proof of age (birth certificate, passport, or driver's license), proof of Medicare enrollment (Medicare card or Medicare Summary Notice), and documentation of gross annual household income (most recent federal tax return, Social Security benefit letter, pension statements, or pay stubs if working).
numberedSteps.es: Paso 1: Reuna sus documentos. Recopile prueba de residencia en Massachusetts, prueba de edad (acta de nacimiento, pasaporte o licencia de conducir), prueba de inscripcion en Medicare (tarjeta de Medicare o Aviso de Resumen de Medicare) y documentacion del ingreso bruto anual del hogar (declaracion de impuestos federal mas reciente, carta de beneficios del Seguro Social, estados de cuenta de pension o talones de pago si trabaja).

numberedSteps.en: Step 2: Choose an application channel. Apply online at prescriptionadvantagema.org (fastest processing), by phone at 1-800-243-4636 (Monday through Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. EST), by mail to the program office in Worcester, MA, or in person at your local Massachusetts Area Agency on Aging.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 2: Elija un canal de solicitud. Solicite en linea en prescriptionadvantagema.org (procesamiento mas rapido), por telefono al 1-800-243-4636 (lunes a viernes, de 9 a.m. a 5 p.m. EST), por correo postal a la oficina del programa en Worcester, MA, o en persona en su Agencia Local de Servicios para Adultos Mayores de Massachusetts.

numberedSteps.en: Step 3: Submit your application with all supporting documents. Online applicants can upload documents or use the online fax option at 508-793-1166. Mail applicants should send copies, not originals. Applications missing documentation will be placed on pending status and you will receive a request for additional information.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 3: Presente su solicitud con todos los documentos de respaldo. Los solicitantes en linea pueden cargar documentos o usar la opcion de fax en linea al 508-793-1166. Los solicitantes por correo deben enviar copias, no originales. Las solicitudes con documentacion incompleta quedaran en estado pendiente y recibira una solicitud de informacion adicional.

numberedSteps.en: Step 4: Receive your income-tier assignment. Once approved, Prescription Advantage assigns you to a membership category (S0 through S4 for Medicare members, or a corresponding tier for non-Medicare members) based on your gross annual household income. Your tier determines your copay amounts and annual out-of-pocket spending cap.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 4: Reciba la asignacion de su nivel de ingresos. Una vez aprobado, Prescription Advantage le asigna una categoria de membresia (S0 a S4 para miembros de Medicare, o un nivel correspondiente para miembros sin Medicare) segun su ingreso bruto anual del hogar. Su nivel determina sus montos de copago y el limite anual de gastos de bolsillo.

numberedSteps.en: Step 5: Enroll in a Medicare Part D plan if you are Medicare-eligible and do not already have one. Prescription Advantage requires Medicare members to have active Part D or Medicare Advantage drug coverage as their primary plan. The SHINE program (1-800-243-4636) provides free counseling to help you pick the right Part D plan alongside Prescription Advantage.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 5: Inscribase en un plan Medicare Parte D si es elegible para Medicare y aun no tiene uno. Prescription Advantage requiere que los miembros de Medicare tengan cobertura activa de la Parte D o Medicare Advantage como plan principal. El programa SHINE (1-800-243-4636) ofrece asesoria gratuita para ayudarle a elegir el plan Parte D correcto junto con Prescription Advantage.

heading.en: Direct Answer: Who Qualifies for Prescription Advantage in 2026
heading.es: Respuesta directa: Quien califica para Prescription Advantage en 2026

paragraphs.en: Yes. Massachusetts residents qualify for Prescription Advantage under one of three tracks: (1) age 65 or older with Medicare and income below 500% FPL ($79,800 for a single person in 2026); (2) age 65 or older without Medicare, no income cap; or (3) under 65 with a qualifying disability, income at or below 188% FPL ($29,985 in 2026), working 40 hours or fewer per month. Active MassHealth drug coverage disqualifies an applicant.
paragraphs.es: Si. Los residentes de Massachusetts califican para Prescription Advantage en una de tres vias: (1) 65 anos o mas con Medicare e ingreso inferior al 500% del FPL ($79,800 para una persona sola en 2026); (2) 65 anos o mas sin Medicare, sin limite de ingresos; o (3) menores de 65 anos con discapacidad calificada, ingreso igual o inferior al 188% del FPL ($29,985 en 2026), trabajando 40 horas o menos por mes. La cobertura activa de medicamentos de MassHealth descalifica al solicitante.

heading.en: Prescription Advantage Income Limits by Household Size (2026)
heading.es: Limites de ingresos de Prescription Advantage por tamano del hogar (2026)

paragraphs.en: Massachusetts uses 2026 federal poverty guidelines to determine Prescription Advantage eligibility. The income ceiling for Medicare-eligible applicants is 500% of the federal poverty level, which rises with household size. All figures below represent gross annual household income ceilings for the Medicare-eligible track; the disability track uses a separate 188% FPL ceiling instead.
paragraphs.es: Massachusetts utiliza las pautas federales de pobreza de 2026 para determinar la elegibilidad de Prescription Advantage. El techo de ingresos para los solicitantes elegibles para Medicare es el 500% del nivel federal de pobreza, que aumenta con el tamano del hogar. Todas las cifras a continuacion representan los techos de ingreso bruto anual del hogar para la via de elegibles de Medicare; la via de discapacidad utiliza un techo separado del 188% del FPL.

paragraphs.en: Once income exceeds the applicable threshold, a Massachusetts resident does not qualify for the Medicare-eligible track but may still qualify for Extra Help (the federal Low-Income Subsidy) if income falls below 150% FPL, or for MassHealth if income falls below 138% FPL. Massachusetts is a Medicaid expansion state, and MassHealth Standard covers adults under 138% FPL ($22,025 for 1 person in 2026).
paragraphs.es: Una vez que el ingreso supera el umbral aplicable, un residente de Massachusetts no califica para la via de elegibles de Medicare, pero aun puede calificar para Extra Help (el Subsidio de Bajos Ingresos federal) si el ingreso cae por debajo del 150% del FPL, o para MassHealth si el ingreso cae por debajo del 138% del FPL. Massachusetts es un estado de expansion de Medicaid, y MassHealth Standard cubre a adultos por debajo del 138% del FPL ($22,025 para 1 persona en 2026).

heading.en: How Prescription Advantage Copay Tiers Work (2026)
heading.es: Como funcionan los niveles de copago de Prescription Advantage (2026)

paragraphs.en: Prescription Advantage assigns Medicare-eligible members to one of five tiers (S0 through S4) based on gross annual household income. Lower-income tiers receive lower copays and lower annual spending caps. The tier assignment determines how the program supplements your Medicare Part D coverage.
paragraphs.es: Prescription Advantage asigna a los miembros elegibles para Medicare uno de cinco niveles (S0 a S4) segun el ingreso bruto anual del hogar. Los niveles de ingresos mas bajos reciben copagos mas bajos y limites de gasto anual mas bajos. La asignacion de nivel determina como el programa complementa su cobertura Medicare Parte D.

paragraphs.en: S0 and S1 members (lower income) pay no more than the Prescription Advantage copay amounts from the first prescription fill, bypassing their Part D plan's deductible and cost-sharing. S2, S3, and S4 members (higher income) pay their Part D plan's deductible and regular copays until the total retail cost of covered medications reaches $5,030 in 2026, at which point Prescription Advantage assumes cost responsibility and members pay only the lower tiered copays. Once any member's annual out-of-pocket spending reaches their tier's cap (ranging from $2,185 to $4,375 in the most recent plan year), Prescription Advantage covers 100% of covered prescription costs for the remainder of the calendar year. Generic drug copays range from approximately $4.50 to $12 per 30-day supply; brand-name drug copays range from approximately $11.20 to $30 per 30-day supply for Medicare-eligible members.
paragraphs.es: Los miembros S0 y S1 (ingresos mas bajos) pagan no mas que los montos de copago de Prescription Advantage desde el primer surtido de receta, evitando el deducible y los costos compartidos de su plan Parte D. Los miembros S2, S3 y S4 (ingresos mas altos) pagan el deducible de su plan Parte D y los copagos regulares hasta que el costo total al por menor de los medicamentos cubiertos alcanza los $5,030 en 2026, momento en que Prescription Advantage asume la responsabilidad de costos y los miembros pagan solo los copagos de nivel inferior. Una vez que el gasto anual de bolsillo de cualquier miembro alcanza el limite de su nivel (que va de $2,185 a $4,375 en el ano del plan mas reciente), Prescription Advantage cubre el 100% de los costos de recetas cubiertas para el resto del ano calendario.

paragraphs.en: Prescription Advantage covers most outpatient prescription drugs that are approved for dispensing at retail pharmacies in Massachusetts. The formulary includes generic drugs, brand-name drugs, and additional brand-name drugs, organized into three cost tiers that correspond to the copay amounts in a member's income tier. Insulin and disposable insulin syringes with needles are explicitly covered under the program.
paragraphs.es: Prescription Advantage cubre la mayoria de los medicamentos recetados ambulatorios aprobados para su dispensacion en farmacias minoristas de Massachusetts. El formulario incluye medicamentos genericos, medicamentos de marca y medicamentos de marca adicionales, organizados en tres niveles de costo que corresponden a los montos de copago en el nivel de ingresos de un miembro. La insulina y las jeringas de insulina desechables con agujas estan cubiertas explicitamente bajo el programa.

paragraphs.en: Prescription Advantage operates as a secondary payer for Medicare-eligible members: it pays after your Medicare Part D plan or Medicare Advantage plan with drug coverage pays first. For members who do not have Medicare (the age-65-plus-no-Medicare track and the disability track), Prescription Advantage can serve as the primary drug coverage source if the member has no other primary plan. Members who have primary coverage from a private insurer receive Prescription Advantage as secondary coverage that wraps around that plan.
paragraphs.es: Prescription Advantage opera como pagador secundario para los miembros elegibles para Medicare: paga despues de que su plan Medicare Parte D o plan Medicare Advantage con cobertura de medicamentos paga primero. Para los miembros que no tienen Medicare (la via de 65 anos o mas sin Medicare y la via de discapacidad), Prescription Advantage puede servir como la fuente principal de cobertura de medicamentos si el miembro no tiene otro plan principal. Los miembros que tienen cobertura principal de un asegurador privado reciben Prescription Advantage como cobertura secundaria que complementa ese plan.

heading.en: How to Apply for Prescription Advantage in Massachusetts
heading.es: Como solicitar Prescription Advantage en Massachusetts

paragraphs.en: Prescription Advantage has no enrollment fee and no annual enrollment window. Massachusetts residents can apply at any time during the year. The fastest way to apply is online at prescriptionadvantagema.org, where applicants can complete the form and upload supporting documents. Telephone applications are processed at 1-800-243-4636 (Monday through Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. EST). Paper applications can be mailed to the Worcester program office or submitted via fax at 508-793-1166.
paragraphs.es: Prescription Advantage no tiene costo de inscripcion ni ventana de inscripcion anual. Los residentes de Massachusetts pueden solicitar en cualquier momento durante el ano. La forma mas rapida de solicitar es en linea en prescriptionadvantagema.org, donde los solicitantes pueden completar el formulario y cargar documentos de respaldo. Las solicitudes telefonicas se procesan al 1-800-243-4636 (lunes a viernes, de 9 a.m. a 5 p.m. EST). Las solicitudes en papel se pueden enviar por correo postal a la oficina del programa en Worcester o por fax al 508-793-1166.

paragraphs.en: Massachusetts' SHINE program (Serving the Health Insurance Needs of Everyone) provides free, unbiased help to Medicare beneficiaries, including assistance with Prescription Advantage applications. SHINE counselors are available at senior centers, libraries, and by phone statewide. To reach a SHINE counselor, call the same number as Prescription Advantage: 1-800-243-4636. SHINE counselors can also help Medicare-eligible applicants identify the best Part D plan to combine with Prescription Advantage to minimize total annual drug costs.
paragraphs.es: El programa SHINE de Massachusetts (Sirviendo las Necesidades de Seguro de Salud de Todos) brinda ayuda gratuita e imparcial a los beneficiarios de Medicare, incluida asistencia con las solicitudes de Prescription Advantage. Los consejeros SHINE estan disponibles en centros para adultos mayores, bibliotecas y por telefono en todo el estado. Para comunicarse con un consejero SHINE, llame al mismo numero que Prescription Advantage: 1-800-243-4636.

heading.en: Is Massachusetts a Medicaid Expansion State?
heading.es: Massachusetts es un estado de expansion de Medicaid?

paragraphs.en: Massachusetts is a Medicaid expansion state and expanded Medicaid well before the Affordable Care Act: the state's 2006 healthcare reform law (Chapter 58) was the model for the ACA. MassHealth Standard, the state's primary Medicaid program, covers adults up to 138% of the federal poverty level ($22,025 for a single person in 2026). Massachusetts also has MassHealth CarePlus for adults between 100% and 133% FPL and several CommonHealth programs for residents with disabilities.
paragraphs.es: Massachusetts es un estado de expansion de Medicaid y expandio Medicaid mucho antes de la Ley del Cuidado de Salud Asequible: la ley de reforma de salud de 2006 del estado (Capitulo 58) fue el modelo para el ACA. MassHealth Standard, el programa principal de Medicaid del estado, cubre a adultos hasta el 138% del nivel federal de pobreza ($22,025 para una persona sola en 2026). Massachusetts tambien tiene MassHealth CarePlus para adultos entre el 100% y el 133% del FPL y varios programas de CommonHealth para residentes con discapacidades.

paragraphs.en: Prescription Advantage occupies a distinct income band above MassHealth but below 500% FPL for Medicare-eligible seniors. Massachusetts residents who qualify for both Prescription Advantage and Extra Help (the federal Low-Income Subsidy for Part D) should apply for Extra Help first through Social Security (ssa.gov/extrahelp), since Extra Help provides additional cost reduction that Prescription Advantage then supplements. Residents who qualify for full MassHealth drug coverage generally receive better benefits through MassHealth than through Prescription Advantage alone and should apply for MassHealth at mahealthconnector.org.
paragraphs.es: Prescription Advantage ocupa una banda de ingresos distinta por encima de MassHealth pero por debajo del 500% del FPL para adultos mayores elegibles para Medicare. Los residentes de Massachusetts que califican tanto para Prescription Advantage como para Extra Help (el Subsidio de Bajos Ingresos federal para la Parte D) deben solicitar Extra Help primero a traves del Seguro Social (ssa.gov/extrahelp), ya que Extra Help proporciona una reduccion de costos adicional que Prescription Advantage luego complementa. Los residentes que califican para la cobertura completa de medicamentos de MassHealth generalmente reciben mejores beneficios a traves de MassHealth que solo a traves de Prescription Advantage y deben solicitar MassHealth en mahealthconnector.org.

heading.en: Common Reasons Prescription Advantage Applications Are Denied
heading.es: Razones comunes por las que se deniegan las solicitudes de Prescription Advantage

paragraphs.en: Prescription Advantage applications are denied for five main reasons. First, income exceeds the applicable FPL ceiling for the applicant's track (500% FPL for Medicare-eligible, 188% FPL for disability-pathway under-65 applicants). Second, the applicant is an active MassHealth or CommonHealth member receiving prescription drug coverage through that program. Third, the application was incomplete or supporting documentation was not provided within the required timeframe after a pending notice was issued. Fourth, the applicant could not verify Massachusetts residency. Fifth, Medicare-eligible applicants who are not enrolled in any Medicare Part D plan or Medicare Advantage plan with drug coverage cannot receive wrap-around benefits because there is no primary coverage for Prescription Advantage to supplement.
paragraphs.es: Las solicitudes de Prescription Advantage se deniegan por cinco razones principales. Primero, el ingreso supera el techo del FPL aplicable para la via del solicitante (500% del FPL para elegibles de Medicare, 188% del FPL para solicitantes menores de 65 anos por la via de discapacidad). Segundo, el solicitante es un miembro activo de MassHealth o CommonHealth que recibe cobertura de medicamentos recetados a traves de ese programa. Tercero, la solicitud estaba incompleta o la documentacion de respaldo no se proporcion dentro del plazo requerido despues de que se emitio un aviso de pendiente. Cuarto, el solicitante no pudo verificar la residencia en Massachusetts. Quinto, los solicitantes elegibles para Medicare que no estan inscritos en ningun plan Medicare Parte D o plan Medicare Advantage con cobertura de medicamentos no pueden recibir beneficios complementarios porque no hay cobertura principal para que Prescription Advantage complemente.

heading.en: How to Appeal a Prescription Advantage Denial
heading.es: Como apelar una denegacion de Prescription Advantage

paragraphs.en: Prescription Advantage denial notices must be issued in writing and must state the specific reason for the denial. Applicants have the right to appeal a denial by requesting a fair hearing through the Massachusetts Board of Hearings. The signed hearing request must typically be received within 60 calendar days of the denial notice. Requests can be submitted by mail, fax, or phone as specified on the denial notice.
paragraphs.es: Los avisos de denegacion de Prescription Advantage deben emitirse por escrito y deben indicar la razon especifica de la denegacion. Los solicitantes tienen derecho a apelar una denegacion solicitando una audiencia justa a traves de la Junta de Audiencias de Massachusetts. La solicitud de audiencia firmada generalmente debe recibirse dentro de los 60 dias calendario posteriores al aviso de denegacion. Las solicitudes se pueden enviar por correo postal, fax o telefono segun se especifica en el aviso de denegacion.

paragraphs.en: Free legal assistance with Prescription Advantage appeals is available through several Massachusetts resources. The Medicare Advocacy Project (MAP) helps people who have been unfairly denied Medicare or state pharmacy benefit program coverage and can provide information, advice, and in some cases representation at no cost. Massachusetts Legal Help (masslegalhelp.org) maintains a guide to Medicare and state health insurance appeals. The SHINE program (1-800-243-4636) can also help applicants understand their appeal rights.
paragraphs.es: Asistencia legal gratuita para apelar Prescription Advantage esta disponible a traves de varios recursos de Massachusetts. El Proyecto de Defensa de Medicare (MAP) ayuda a personas que han sido injustamente negadas en cobertura de Medicare o programas estatales de beneficios de farmacia y puede proporcionar informacion, asesoria y en algunos casos representacion sin costo. Massachusetts Legal Help (masslegalhelp.org) mantiene una guia para apelaciones de Medicare y seguro de salud estatal. El programa SHINE (1-800-243-4636) tambien puede ayudar a los solicitantes a comprender sus derechos de apelacion.

en.question: What is the income limit for Prescription Advantage in Massachusetts for 2026?
en.answer: For Medicare-eligible residents 65 or older, the 2026 income ceiling is 500% of the federal poverty level: $79,800 for a single person, $107,700 for a two-person household. The limit rises by $27,900 for each additional household member. Residents 65 or older who do not have Medicare have no income limit. Adults under 65 with a qualifying disability must have income at or below 188% FPL, which is $29,985 for a single person in 2026.

en.question: What is Prescription Advantage and how is it different from MassHealth?
en.answer: Prescription Advantage is Massachusetts' State Pharmaceutical Assistance Program (SPAP), focused specifically on prescription drug costs for seniors and people with disabilities. MassHealth is Massachusetts' full Medicaid program covering medical, hospital, and drug benefits for lower-income residents. Prescription Advantage targets a higher income band (up to 500% FPL) and wraps around Medicare Part D coverage. If you qualify for MassHealth's drug coverage, you generally cannot receive Prescription Advantage benefits at the same time.

en.question: Do I need to be on Medicare to join Prescription Advantage?
en.answer: No. Massachusetts Prescription Advantage has three eligibility tracks: one for Medicare-eligible residents 65 or older (income limit applies), one for residents 65 or older without Medicare (no income limit), and one for adults under 65 with a qualifying disability who meet the 188% FPL income limit and work 40 hours or fewer per month. However, Medicare-eligible applicants must be enrolled in a Medicare Part D plan before Prescription Advantage can wrap around it.

en.question: What copays does Prescription Advantage charge in 2026?
en.answer: Copays depend on your income tier (S0 through S4 for Medicare members). Generic drug copays range from approximately $4.50 to $12 per 30-day supply; brand-name drug copays range from approximately $11.20 to $30 per 30-day supply. Lower-income tiers (S0 and S1) pay these reduced copays starting with the first prescription. Higher-income tiers (S2-S4) pay their Part D plan's standard cost-sharing until covered drug costs reach $5,030, then the reduced Prescription Advantage copays apply. Contact 1-800-243-4636 for the exact 2026 rate schedule.

en.question: What happens when I reach my Prescription Advantage spending cap?
en.answer: Once your annual out-of-pocket drug spending reaches your tier's cap (ranging from approximately $2,185 for the lowest tier to $4,375 for the highest tier in the Medicare track), Prescription Advantage pays 100% of covered prescription costs for the rest of the calendar year. You pay $0 in covered drug costs after reaching the cap, providing a firm annual ceiling on prescription spending.

en.question: Can I have Prescription Advantage and Extra Help (Low-Income Subsidy) at the same time?
en.answer: Yes, and you should apply for Extra Help first. Extra Help, the federal Low-Income Subsidy for Medicare Part D, reduces your Part D premiums, deductible, and copays if your income is below 150% FPL. Prescription Advantage then wraps around your Part D plan to further reduce costs. Receiving both programs together maximizes your savings. Apply for Extra Help through Social Security at ssa.gov/extrahelp or call 1-800-772-1213.

en.question: Is there a fee to enroll in Prescription Advantage?
en.answer: No. There are no application fees, enrollment fees, or monthly premiums charged by Prescription Advantage itself. You still pay your Medicare Part D plan's separate premium, but Prescription Advantage charges nothing for membership. The program's cost-sharing is limited to the tiered copay amounts determined by your income level.

en.question: How long does Prescription Advantage enrollment take?
en.answer: Processing time varies by application channel. Online applications submitted with complete documentation are typically processed faster than paper applications. Incomplete applications are placed on pending status and require additional documentation. For the most current processing timeframes, contact Prescription Advantage at 1-800-243-4636. Coverage begins once the program confirms your eligibility and tier assignment.

es.question: Cual es el limite de ingresos para Prescription Advantage en Massachusetts para 2026?
es.answer: Para residentes elegibles para Medicare de 65 anos o mas, el techo de ingresos de 2026 es el 500% del nivel federal de pobreza: $79,800 para una persona sola, $107,700 para un hogar de dos personas. El limite aumenta en $27,900 por cada miembro adicional del hogar. Los residentes de 65 anos o mas que no tienen Medicare no tienen limite de ingresos. Los adultos menores de 65 anos con una discapacidad calificada deben tener ingresos iguales o inferiores al 188% del FPL, que es $29,985 para una persona sola en 2026.

es.question: Que es Prescription Advantage y en que se diferencia de MassHealth?
es.answer: Prescription Advantage es el Programa Estatal de Asistencia Farmaceutica (SPAP) de Massachusetts, enfocado especificamente en los costos de medicamentos recetados para adultos mayores y personas con discapacidades. MassHealth es el programa completo de Medicaid de Massachusetts que cubre beneficios medicos, hospitalarios y de medicamentos para residentes de bajos ingresos. Prescription Advantage atiende una banda de ingresos mas alta (hasta el 500% del FPL) y complementa la cobertura Medicare Parte D. Si califica para la cobertura de medicamentos de MassHealth, generalmente no puede recibir los beneficios de Prescription Advantage al mismo tiempo.

es.question: Necesito estar en Medicare para unirme a Prescription Advantage?
es.answer: No. Massachusetts Prescription Advantage tiene tres vias de elegibilidad: una para residentes elegibles para Medicare de 65 anos o mas (aplica limite de ingresos), una para residentes de 65 anos o mas sin Medicare (sin limite de ingresos) y una para adultos menores de 65 anos con una discapacidad calificada que cumplen el limite de ingresos del 188% del FPL y trabajan 40 horas o menos por mes. Sin embargo, los solicitantes elegibles para Medicare deben estar inscritos en un plan Medicare Parte D antes de que Prescription Advantage pueda complementarlo.

es.question: Que copagos cobra Prescription Advantage en 2026?
es.answer: Los copagos dependen de su nivel de ingresos (S0 a S4 para miembros de Medicare). Los copagos de medicamentos genericos oscilan entre aproximadamente $4.50 y $12 por suministro de 30 dias; los copagos de medicamentos de marca oscilan entre aproximadamente $11.20 y $30 por suministro de 30 dias. Los niveles de ingresos mas bajos (S0 y S1) pagan estos copagos reducidos desde la primera receta. Los niveles de ingresos mas altos (S2-S4) pagan el costo estandar de su plan Parte D hasta que los costos de medicamentos cubiertos alcanzan $5,030, luego se aplican los copagos reducidos de Prescription Advantage.

es.question: Que sucede cuando alcanzo mi limite de gasto de Prescription Advantage?
es.answer: Una vez que su gasto anual de bolsillo en medicamentos alcanza el limite de su nivel (que va desde aproximadamente $2,185 para el nivel mas bajo hasta $4,375 para el nivel mas alto en la via de Medicare), Prescription Advantage paga el 100% de los costos de recetas cubiertas por el resto del ano calendario. No paga nada en costos de medicamentos cubiertos despues de alcanzar el limite.

es.question: Puedo tener Prescription Advantage y Extra Help (Subsidio de Bajos Ingresos) al mismo tiempo?
es.answer: Si, y debe solicitar Extra Help primero. Extra Help, el Subsidio de Bajos Ingresos federal para Medicare Parte D, reduce las primas, el deducible y los copagos de su plan Parte D si sus ingresos estan por debajo del 150% del FPL. Prescription Advantage luego complementa su plan Parte D para reducir aun mas los costos. Solicite Extra Help a traves del Seguro Social en ssa.gov/extrahelp o llame al 1-800-772-1213.

es.question: Hay una tarifa para inscribirse en Prescription Advantage?
es.answer: No. No hay tarifas de solicitud, tarifas de inscripcion ni primas mensuales cobradas por Prescription Advantage. Todavia paga la prima separada de su plan Medicare Parte D, pero Prescription Advantage no cobra nada por la membresia. El costo compartido del programa se limita a los montos de copago por nivel determinados por su nivel de ingresos.

es.question: Cuanto tiempo tarda la inscripcion en Prescription Advantage?
es.answer: El tiempo de procesamiento varia segun el canal de solicitud. Las solicitudes en linea enviadas con documentacion completa generalmente se procesan mas rapido que las solicitudes en papel. Las solicitudes incompletas se colocan en estado pendiente y requieren documentacion adicional. Para los plazos de procesamiento mas actuales, comuniquese con Prescription Advantage al 1-800-243-4636.
